description: A comprehensive example showing how to structure features

features.description: User can log in with email and password
acceptance_criteria: Login form displays email and password fields
Form validates email format before submission
Form validates password is not empty
Successful login redirects to dashboard
Failed login shows error message
Loading state shown during authentication

features.description: User can log out from any page
acceptance_criteria: Logout button visible in header when authenticated
Clicking logout clears session
User redirected to login page after logout
Protected routes inaccessible after logout

features.description: Application layout is responsive across device sizes
acceptance_criteria: Layout adapts to mobile viewport (< 768px)
Layout adapts to tablet viewport (768px - 1024px)
Layout works on desktop viewport (> 1024px)
Navigation collapses to hamburger menu on mobile
No horizontal scrolling on any viewport

features.description: User can toggle between light and dark themes
acceptance_criteria: Theme toggle visible in settings or header
Dark mode applies to all components
Theme preference persists across sessions
No flash of wrong theme on page load
All text remains readable in both themes

features.description: Routes are lazy loaded to reduce initial bundle size
acceptance_criteria: Each main route is code-split
Loading indicator shown during route transitions
Initial bundle size under 200KB (gzipped)
Route chunks load in under 500ms on 3G

features.description: All mutations are protected against CSRF attacks
acceptance_criteria: CSRF token included in all POST/PUT/DELETE requests
Server validates CSRF token on protected endpoints
Token refreshed appropriately

features.description: All interactive elements are keyboard accessible
acceptance_criteria: Tab order follows logical flow
Focus indicators visible on all focusable elements
Escape key closes modals and dropdowns
Enter/Space activates buttons and links
Arrow keys navigate within composite widgets

features.description: Application is usable with screen readers
acceptance_criteria: All images have appropriate alt text
Form inputs have associated labels
ARIA landmarks define page regions
Dynamic content announced via live regions
Error messages announced to screen readers
